::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 29th [1864]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd),
I am afraid the [Clever Woman](cmy_books/cmybook_58.qmd) cannot come out till March, as [Hogg](organizations/other_159.qmd) gives me no hope of finishing her before that time—so it would be hardly worth while to begin printing her till the beginning of the year.

I have sent all the rest of the [Golden Deeds](cmy_books/cmybook_51.qmd) direct to the printers, they will end with [Dr. Kane.](people/person_1915.qmd)

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge
